standfirst: Encephalomyocarditis virus, Theiler's murine encephalomyelitis virus and Saffold virus in one module. Fifteen features and 72 profiles: thirteen polyprotein products built at the documented defaults, plus the two proteins cardioviruses make out of frame with that polyprotein — L*, an ordinary PSSM feature, and 2B*, which is not collinear with the genome and is called from a set of per-genome nucleotide references instead.

modules.Cardiovirus: The leader is a 67-76 residue zinc-finger host antagonist, not a protease, which is why this genus is separate from Aphthovirus whose leader occupies the same slot at 201 residues. Only POLY carries copy_num.

gaps: No declared feature lacks a profile. 2B* has no PSSM by design: it is a transcript-edited feature called from 80 nucleotide references, all from C. rueckerti, which is the only species carrying the long +2 ORF.
derived: Thirteen mature peptides are cleavage products of POLY with both extensions set to 0. L* is a separate CDS overlapping POLY in another frame, so kmers is 0. 2B* is a -1 ribosomal frameshift product sharing its N-terminus with 2B; its reference set round-trips byte-identically on 12 of 12 donor genomes.
